name: Chikuma Harushige
source:
Accountant at Mado Psychics and Suzu's childhood friend. The protagonist's former coworker. Good-natured and kind to everyone, he's quite sympathetic. Very reliable, but not great when it comes to horror or the occult.

[From Love 365's in-app character introduction.]
